Messages.Author: TONY RICARDI
Messages.Body:
If a Malk takes an out-of-turn action using the Madness Net, can another
vamp assume this action with Mask of 1000 Faces?

Idea:

Put out a weenie Malk or two.

Put out Madness Net.

Put out Masika.

Give him Obfuscate.

At the end of your prey's turn, when your prey is mostly tapped out,
bleed with a Malk, then use M1KF to bounce the action to Masika,
untapping the Malk. At the end of the turn, untap Masika. Repeat this
at the end of _every_ players turn! When your prey runs out of blockers
and wakey-wakey, have the Malks come in with DOM bleed boosters. You
could easily take out a player at 15 or so blood this way.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
tony.r...@swcbbs.com (TONY RICARDI) writes:

>If a Malk takes an out-of-turn action using the Madness Net, can another
>vamp assume this action with Mask of 1000 Faces?

No, because you cannot play action modifiers except on your own turn.
(VtES Rulebook, Sec 3.2.2)

>Idea:

>Put out a weenie Malk or two.

>Put out Madness Net.

>Put out Masika.

>Give him Obfuscate.

>At the end of your prey's turn, when your prey is mostly tapped out,
>bleed with a Malk, then use M1KF to bounce the action to Masika,
>untapping the Malk. At the end of the turn, untap Masika. Repeat this
>at the end of _every_ players turn! When your prey runs out of blockers
>and wakey-wakey, have the Malks come in with DOM bleed boosters. You
>could easily take out a player at 15 or so blood this way.

You could get close to this idea by putting a Homunculus on one of
your Malks. 'Course that untapping costs one blood each time, so a
Mortician, Hunting Grounds, Rack, and 5th Tradition would need to be
added.
